questions: What is the full name of GECK?
answer_en: GECK stands for Government Engineering College Kozhikode.
answer_ml: GECK എന്നത് Government Engineering College Kozhikode എന്നാണ്.

answer_en: GECK is located in Kozhikode, Kerala, in the Malabar region.
answer_ml: GECK കേരളത്തിലെ കോഴിക്കോട്, മലബാർ മേഖലയിലാണ് സ്ഥിതി ചെയ്യുന്നത്.

answer_en: GECK was established by the Government of Kerala during the academic year 1999–2000.
answer_ml: കേരള സർക്കാർ 1999–2000 അധ്യയന വർഷത്തിലാണ് GECK സ്ഥാപിച്ചത്.

answer_en: Yes. GECK is an ISO 9001:2015 certified institution.
answer_ml: അതെ. GECK ഒരു ISO 9001:2015 സർട്ടിഫൈഡ് സ്ഥാപനമാണ്.

questions: What undergraduate programme does GECK offer?
answer_en: GECK offers full-time B.Tech degree programmes.
answer_ml: GECK പൂർണ്ണകാല B.Tech ഡിഗ്രി പ്രോഗ്രാമുകൾ നൽകുന്നു.

questions: How many BTech branches are available?
How many departments are there in BTech?
answer_en: Six B.Tech branches are available.
answer_ml: ആറ് B.Tech ബ്രാഞ്ചുകൾ ലഭ്യമാണ്.

questions: What are the BTech branches at GECK?
answer_en:
B.Tech branches:
• Applied Electronics and Instrumentation
• Chemical Engineering
• Electronics and Communication Engineering
• Mechanical Engineering
• Civil Engineering
• Computer Science and Design
answer_ml:
B.Tech ബ്രാഞ്ചുകൾ:
• Applied Electronics and Instrumentation
• Chemical Engineering
• Electronics and Communication Engineering
• Mechanical Engineering
• Civil Engineering
• Computer Science and Design

questions: What is the duration of BTech at GECK?
answer_en: The B.Tech programmes have a duration of 8 semesters.
answer_ml: B.Tech പ്രോഗ്രാമുകളുടെ ദൈർഘ്യം 8 സെമസ്റ്ററുകളാണ്.

questions: What is the annual intake for each BTech branch?
How many seats in each branch?
answer_en: The annual intake is 66 students in each B.Tech branch.
answer_ml: ഓരോ B.Tech ബ്രാഞ്ചിലും വാർഷിക പ്രവേശനം 66 വിദ്യാർത്ഥികളാണ്.

answer_en:
M.Tech programmes:
• Signal Processing
• Energy Systems Analysis and Design
• Computer Aided Process Design
• Structural Engineering
answer_ml:
M.Tech പ്രോഗ്രാമുകൾ:
• Signal Processing
• Energy Systems Analysis and Design
• Computer Aided Process Design
• Structural Engineering

questions: Which universities is GECK affiliated with?
answer_en: GECK is affiliated with the University of Calicut and APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University.
answer_ml: GECK University of Calicut-നും APJ Abdul Kalam Technological University-ക്കും അനുബന്ധമാണ്.

answer_en: Yes. GECK is recognized by the All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE).
answer_ml: അതെ. GECK-ന് All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE) അംഗീകാരം ഉണ്ട്.

questions: When is admission for the 2026-27 batch?
When should I come for admission?
answer_en: Admission for the 2026–27 batch is scheduled for September 10, 2026.
answer_ml: 2026–27 ബാച്ചിന്റെ അഡ്മിഷൻ 2026 സെപ്റ്റംബർ 10-ന് നിശ്ചയിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നു.

questions: What time does admission begin on September 10?
What time should I report for admission?
answer_en: Admission begins at 9:30 AM on September 10, 2026.
answer_ml: 2026 സെപ്റ്റംബർ 10-ന് അഡ്മിഷൻ രാവിലെ 9:30-ന് ആരംഭിക്കുന്നു.

questions: When should sports admission students report?
What time for sports quota admission?
answer_en: Students under the sports admission scheme should reach the college at 11:00 AM.
answer_ml: Sports admission scheme പ്രകാരമുള്ള വിദ്യാർത്ഥികൾ രാവിലെ 11:00 മണിക്ക് കോളേജിലെത്തണം.

questions: Is sports admission based on KEAM ranking?
Is KEAM required for sports admission?
answer_en: Yes. Sports admission is based on the KEAM rank list, and KEAM qualification is required for the admission described in the provided information.
answer_ml: അതെ. Sports admission KEAM rank list അടിസ്ഥാനമാക്കിയുള്ളതാണ്; നൽകിയ വിവരമനുസരിച്ച് KEAM qualification ആവശ്യമാണ്.

questions: What documents are required for admission?
What should I bring for admission?
answer_en: Bring the KEAM Data Sheet, KEAM Admit Card, original SSLC certificate with two attested copies, original Plus Two/Higher Secondary certificate with two attested copies, date-of-birth certificate, Transfer Certificate, Conduct Certificate, Migration Certificate where applicable, Physical Fitness Certificate, one recent passport-size photograph, relevant category certificates where applicable, and other documents required by the KEAM Prospectus.
answer_ml: അഡ്മിഷനായി KEAM Data Sheet, KEAM Admit Card, original SSLC certificate + 2 attested copies, original Plus Two/Higher Secondary certificate + 2 attested copies, date-of-birth certificate, Transfer Certificate, Conduct Certificate, ബാധകമെങ്കിൽ Migration Certificate, Physical Fitness Certificate, ഒരു recent passport-size photo, ബാധകമായ category certificates, കൂടാതെ KEAM Prospectus പ്രകാരമുള്ള മറ്റ് രേഖകൾ കൊണ്ടുവരണം.

questions: How many copies of KEAM data sheet?
Do I need KEAM data sheet?
answer_en: Yes. Two copies of the KEAM Data Sheet 2026 are required.
answer_ml: അതെ. KEAM Data Sheet 2026-ന്റെ 2 കോപ്പികൾ ആവശ്യമാണ്.

Do I need KEAM admit card?
answer_en: Yes. Two copies of the KEAM Admit Card 2026 are required.

answer_en: Yes. The original SSLC certificate and two attested copies are required.

questions: Do I need higher secondary certificate?
answer_en: Yes. The original Plus Two/Higher Secondary Examination Certificate and two attested copies are required.
answer_ml: അതെ. Original Plus Two/Higher Secondary Examination Certificate-ും 2 attested copies-ും ആവശ്യമാണ്.

answer_en: Yes. A Transfer Certificate (TC) from the institution last attended is required.
answer_ml: അതെ. അവസാനമായി പഠിച്ച സ്ഥാപനത്തിൽ നിന്നുള്ള Transfer Certificate (TC) ആവശ്യമാണ്.

answer_en: Yes. A Conduct Certificate from the institution last attended is required.
answer_ml: അതെ. അവസാനമായി പഠിച്ച സ്ഥാപനത്തിൽ നിന്നുള്ള Conduct Certificate ആവശ്യമാണ്.

answer_en: A Migration Certificate is required wherever applicable.
answer_ml: ബാധകമായ സാഹചര്യങ്ങളിൽ Migration Certificate ആവശ്യമാണ്.

answer_en: Yes. A Physical Fitness Certificate is required.
answer_ml: അതെ. Physical Fitness Certificate ആവശ്യമാണ്.

Do I need photo for admission?
